description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) "I could swear It spoke to the beast.It came to a halt, as if calmly listening to the leaves rustling, and then... grinned."
descriptionRuRaw: Дарует возможность убить всех выживших, которых вы перед этим повесили на крюк, и которые достигли на нем второй стадии, в следующем матче. Секретное.

Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes you to spawn as far away from the Killer as possible. "I found marvels through the years in The Fog, but only now do I understand how to bend The Fog's irrefragable rules." — Vigo's Journal

description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) description: Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes your Add-ons to not be consumed after ending the Trial. "Hear my voice, spare my ways, protect me from the void."

description: Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes your held Item to be protected from loss upon death. Causes any attached Add-ons to not be consumed upon death or escaping the Trial. "Keep me from evil, defend me, and pass away."
